sourceSnapshot.detail: The existing bounded quarantine function is SECURITY INVOKER, owns the exact JSON validation and live claim predicate, and grants EXECUTE only to notification_worker.
Slice5 replaces notification_worker's permissive FOR ALL policy with pending/processing SELECT and processing/quarantined UPDATE policies so terminal rows are not readable.
The reviewed v11 transaction-local bridge already supplies bounded ownership-transfer authority to notification_event_trigger and is removed before commit.

The single-event quarantine helper still performs a direct UPDATE while the batch/projector path invokes notification_quarantine_claims(jsonb). Both must converge on one fixed authority surface after Slice5.
The shared worker transaction initializes generation but not scope mode, event ID or quarantine reason; the amendment must initialize every setting that the fixed function captures and restores.

The production projector sends malformed claimed events through the existing bounded quarantine function and requires exactly one settled row, but its distinct claim transaction initializes scope/event/generation without initializing quarantine reason.
Runtime admission already captures exact operational ACLs, policies, role reachability and four fixed functions; the quarantine owner/function/policies must join that finite inventory.

failureEvidence.test: uses the command tag for exact claim-role quarantine while terminal SELECT remains denied
failureEvidence.databaseError: new row violates row-level security policy for table notification_outbox
failureEvidence.interpretation: The terminal-read restriction is effective, but a SECURITY INVOKER update cannot both write the terminal row and retain that restriction.

reviewFindings.detail: Integrity quarantine cannot commit after Slice5 without either reopening terminal SELECT to notification_worker or using a fixed inaccessible authority.
The authority must not accept dynamic SQL, relation names, roles or free-form reasons and must preserve exact live organization, event, owner and generation fencing.
The notification worker and all browser/application roles must remain unable to read terminal outbox rows or reach the definer owner.
The current single-event and 250-event callers must keep their exact boolean/count behavior while sharing one database mutation path.
